title: The sectionwise and monoidal tensor presentation isomorphisms
statement: On a site $(\mathcal C,J)$ essentially small in the coefficient universe, let $R$ be a commutative ring sheaf and $M,N$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The sheafified sectionwise tensor and its monoidal localization are those of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Define siteTensorRightIso to be the identity on sectionwise pure tensors from the explicit presheaf tensor functor to the monoidal presheaf tensor functor. Define tensorRightPresentation by the monoidal module-sheafification comparison and its invertible counit on sheaves. Define siteSheafTensorRightIso as sheafification of the sectionwise comparison followed by the inverse presentation, giving a natural isomorphism $(-\otimes_{\mathrm{site}} M)\cong(-\otimes_{\mathrm{mon}} M)$. These are the existing canonical isomorphisms, not an assertion of tensor colimit preservation.
